      Our Locations in Hoi An

      Four Phin spaces, each with its own character — from Hoi An Old Town and An Bang Beach to our coffee roastery in Triem Tay village

      Coffee • Food • Breakfast & Brunch • Coffee Experiences

      Phin Coffee Restaurant — Hoi An Old Town

      Our main restaurant in Hoi An Old Town brings together Vietnamese coffee, breakfast and brunch, local favourites and the fusion dishes we’ve developed in our kitchen.

      Set in our new home, you’ll find a leafy outdoor garden and an air-conditioned indoor space — comfortable for breakfast, lunch or dinner throughout the day.

      Coffee • Breakfast • Lunch • Dinner • Vietnamese & Fusion Food

      Explore Restaurant Google Map

      Phin Lounge An Bang — Near An Bang Beach

      Just a short walk from An Bang Beach, Phin Lounge is our relaxed garden café and restaurant — a place for coffee, breakfast, lunch, dinner or a drink after the beach.

      The menu brings together Vietnamese favourites, breakfast and brunch, and our own fusion dishes, alongside Phin coffee, fresh drinks and cocktails.

      With a leafy outdoor garden and plenty of space to slow down, it’s an easy place to spend a little longer.

      Coffee • Breakfast & Brunch • Lunch • Dinner • Cocktails

      Explore Phin Lounge Google Map

      Phin Brunch — Breakfast & Coffee in Hoi An Old Town

      Phin Brunch is our breakfast and brunch spot in Hoi An Old Town, built around good coffee and the kind of morning food we enjoy eating ourselves.

      The menu ranges from Vietnamese breakfast favourites to eggs, homemade breads, healthy bowls and familiar brunch dishes, all served alongside Phin coffee.

      A relaxed place for breakfast, brunch and coffee before heading out to explore Hoi An.

      Breakfast • Brunch • Vietnamese Coffee • Fresh & Healthy Choices

      Explore Phin Brunch Google Map

      Phin Lab Roastery — Triem Tay Village

      Phin Lab is where we explore coffee beyond the cup. Set in the quiet village of Triem Tay, our working roastery is where we roast, taste and continue learning about Vietnamese coffee.

      It is also home to some of our deeper coffee experiences, where guests can learn about beans, processing, roasting and how flavour develops from green coffee to the final cup.

      Phin Lab is not a regular café and visits are generally arranged as part of a coffee experience or by booking.

      Coffee Roasting • Tasting • Coffee Experiences • By Booking

      Explore Phin Lab Google Map

      Three Restaurants. One Phin Coffee.

      Across our Phin Coffee Hoi An locations, each restaurant has its own atmosphere and menu focus, but the coffee is the same — roasted by us and brewed with the same approach across Phin.

      Behind them is Phin Lab Roastery, where we roast, taste and keep developing the coffee served across our locations.

      Three restaurants • One roastery • One Phin
